decisions: One i386 absolute-table discovery feature; no ARM conditional-return or x86-64 delta-table expansion.
Reject an unbounded cases=None integration: a four-case table followed by a callback word already produces a false fifth xrefs edge.
Require the range proof to constrain the actual table index at its machine width, prevent guard bypass, clobbers and unproved wrap, and preserve true function entries.
Instruction membership never becomes a min/max case span: preserve independent entries and undefined gaps between case blocks.
Resolve missing predecessor evidence deterministically across serial, parallel, and resumed walks.
Default-off development; any default-on recommendation requires fresh recall, parity, and speed evidence.
This proposal neither implements a fix nor satisfies the original #299 crackme acceptance criterion.
Implemented as post-walk reconciliation over the finished partition with an isolated candidate, at most 16 admission rounds, whole-candidate fallback on instability, budget or revalidation failure.
Accepts one movzx of the compared register into the index (between the guard and the jump, between the comparison and the guard, or above the comparison); memory compares and reloads are refused.
A case table entry on an existing function entry refuses the dispatch.
An extended Listing is rebuilt from its seeds on resume.
Stays default-off: 13 true starts lost on the i386 sweep, each accounted above.
